svg.text: HomeFM block diagram: training and inference

HomeFM is encoder-only (no decoder). Transformers in the system: MiniLM (encoder, frozen), attribute fusion (1 layer), moment encoder (cross-attention), stream transformer, event read-out, game-2 predictor, LLM agent (decoder-only, frozen).
Learned neural network (linear / MLP / embedding table)
A · TRAINING (offline, server GPU, once per model release)
HomeFM backbone: encoder-only, every block below is learned
Value: Embedding(ON / OFF / NA) + MLP on number (NN)
When: sin/cos of hour and weekday (fixed formula)
across the 4 attribute vectors (+ type tags)
DomusFM equivalent: 5 attributes, no value/meta nets
attend to the minute's event vectors
0 to 256 events in, always 1 vector out
each event vector + the context of
GAME 1 · predict the next event (variant D)
device: dot product with this home's device-table rows
time until next: mixture of 8 log-normals
later reused for forecasts and the surprise score
how wrong the guesses about the next event were
GAME 2 · hide a big chunk, predict its meaning (variant C)
sees the full window · no gradients
student HomeFM on the masked window → guess the hidden minutes' vectors
teacher updated as 99.6 % old + 0.4 % new after each round
GAME 3 · match with sentences (added in variant F)
pull matching minutes and sentences together
Total loss = Loss 1 + Loss 2 (+ Loss 3) → backpropagation + AdamW optimiser
nudges every learned (blue / purple) block a little · 20,000 rounds × 32 windows of 30 minutes · MiniLM and the teacher copy are never nudged by gradients
→ tested on 7 unseen homes · → distilled to a small student (planned)
B · INFERENCE (on the home hub, continuous; weights frozen)
one per event, as in training
Device registry + tag vocabulary (built at onboarding)
MiniLM numbers per device and per detector tag
loaded into memory; one model file serves every home
Trained HomeFM (student): the same 4 blocks as in training, weights FROZEN
1 Event embedder → 2 Moment encoder → 3 Stream transformer → contextual minute vectors (4 Event read-out → contextual event vectors)
Live mode: causal mask, every minute ("what is happening now") · Look-back mode: bidirectional mask, about every hour (corrects the recent past)
No games and no losses at inference: nothing is nudged. Only the heads below run on the outputs.
any activity sentence · several at once
P, Q from game 3 · per-minute version planned
each minute's vector placed on the
switch on high / off low · merge short gaps
surprise + rarity + routine drift · always with an explanation
each device vs its own past and similar devices
plain rows with text labels, times and confidence: what the agent mostly reads
writes the answer · never does the maths
→ nearest minutes in the vector store
tools read the SQL tables, the event store and the vector store

"planned" = designed but not implemented yet. Built today: converters, device table, Home Tokens, event embedder, moment encoder, stream transformer (both modes), event read-out, next-event head, games 1–3 (per-window alignment).
